State of New Mexico

Michelle Lujan Grisham

Governor

EXECUTIVE ORDER 2026-089
AUTHORIZING ADDITIONAL EMERGENCY FUNDS FOR THE
NEW MEXICO NATIONAL GUARD DUE TO FLOODING ACROSS
NEW MEXICO

WHEREAS, heavy rainfall has resulted in flooding and flash flooding in multiple areas of
New Mexico, and additional rainfall is forecast to create continued flooding conditions across the
State;

WHEREAS, flooding has damaged public infrastructure, disrupted transportation routes,
threatened homes and businesses, and endangered public health and safety;

WHEREAS, local emergency response agencies have committed substantial resources to
flooding response operations;

WHEREAS, flooding conditions may continue to develop in additional communities,
requiring rapid deployment of State resources;

WHEREAS, this disaster is of such magnitude as to be beyond local control and requires
the resources of the State of New Mexico to minimize economic and physical harm and to take
actions necessary to protect the public health, safety, and welfare;

WHEREAS, | initially declared a state of emergency due to flooding across New Mexico

on July 23, 2026, and released emergency funding to the Department of Homeland Security and

Emergency Management and the New Mexico National Guard; and

State Capitol * Room400 + Santa Fe, New Mexico 87501 * 505-476-2200

 WHEREAS, the New Mexico National Guard requires additional funding to protect public
peace, health, and safety in response to this disaster.

NOW, THEREFORE, I, Michelle Lujan Grisham, Governor of the State of New Mexico,
by virtue of the authority vested in me by the Constitution and the laws of the State of New Mexico
do hereby DECLARE a state of emergency to exist, and ORDER and DIRECT as follows:

1. The Department of Finance and Administration shall make available emergency
financial resources in an amount not to exceed seven hundred fifty thousand dollars ($750,000.00)
to the New Mexico National Guard in accordance with NMSA 1978, Sections 12-11-23 to -25,
and NMSA 1978, Sections 12-10-14 to -15. The funds shall be expended for the resources and
services necessary to avoid or minimize economic or physical harm until the situation becomes
stabilized; on a temporary, emergency basis for lodging, sheltering, health care, food, any
transportation or shipping necessary to protect lives or public property; or for any other action
necessary to protect the public health, safety, welfare, and property. The funds shall be expended
in accordance with the policy and procedures of the Department of Military Affairs, as approved
by the Governor or her Authorized Representative.

2. The Department of Military Affairs shall coordinate all requests for assistance and
responses to such requests under the authority of and as determined by the Governor or her
Authorized Representative. In addition to such other eligibility criteria as may be established by
the Governor or her Authorized Representative, applicants requesting financial assistance from the
State for necessary action taken in response to the emergency shall be required to demonstrate that
the cost of the necessary action exceeds their available resources, as determined based upon criteria
developed in conjunction with the State agencies, if any, with financial and budgetary oversight

responsibilities for the applicant.

 3. The Adjutant General shall order into service any elements of the New Mexico
National Guard as are or may be needed to provide military support to civil authorities as needed
for this emergency. This action is pursuant to and in accordance with NMSA 1978, Sections 20-
1-1 to -8, NMSA 1978, Sections 20-2-1 to -8, and NMSA 1978, Sections 20-4-1 to -14. Such
emergency assistance shall be provided during the period of need at the discretion of the Governor
or her Authorized Representative.

4. All Cabinet Departments and agencies under gubernatorial control shall provide
any assistance that may be required by the Department of Military Affairs under the authority of
the Governor’s Authorized Representative.

I FURTHER ORDER and DIRECT as follows:

1, This Order supersedes any previous orders, proclamations, or directives to the
extent they are in conflict.

2. This Order shall take effect immediately and shall remain in effect until all

authorized funds are expended or no longer necessary to provide emergency assistance.
